Each lane config entry has a `dataFile` field (e.g. `"上路.json"`). - **Returned data used to**: Build `rawData` keyed by lane name; passed into `computeLOLM(rawData)` to produce the structured `gameData`. ### Call site B -- Line 289 (inside `loadGameData`, non-laned / hasDates branch) ``` const resp = await fetch(base + "/" + dataFile); ``` - **When**: `loadGameData()` with `gameConfig.hasLanes === false` (i.e. 曙光英雄), where `dataFile` is resolved from the dates list. - **URL example**: `曙光英雄/曙光英雄_2026-08-02.json` - **Logic**: `dataFile` is set at lines 282-288 -- if `hasDates` is true, it picks the entry matching `currentDate` (or falls back to `gameConfig.dates[0]`); otherwise it uses `gameConfig.dataFile`. - **Returned data used to**: Pass to `computeSG(rawData)` to build `gameData.heroes` / `gameData.sorted`. ### Call site C -- Line 308 (inside `loadGameData`, previous-date comparison) ``` const prevResp = await fetch(base + "/" + prevEntry.file); ``` - **When**: `loadGameData()` with `hasDates === true` AND `gameConfig.dates.length >= 2` AND there is a previous date index (`curIdx > 0`). This is inside a `try/catch` (line 322: "silent failure"). - **URL example**: `曙光英雄/曙光英雄_2026-07-20.json` (the file from the chronologically-previous date). - **Returned data used to**: Compute previous-period tiers/ranks/scores and attach `prevTier`, `prevScore`, `prevRank` to each hero object (lines 311-320). These are used later in the render (line 426) to show green-up / red-down arrows for tier changes. ### Call site D -- Line 940 (inside `switchGame`) ``` const configResp = await fetch(base + "/config.json"); ``` - **When**: `switchGame(gameId)` is called (line 932+). - **URL**: Either `lolm/config.json` or `曙光英雄/config.json`. - **Returned data used to**: Set the global `gameConfig` variable (line 942).
